accepted_scope: Real-arithmetic full-box C2 rectangle/n-way bounds, exact toy examples, and the eta/nu argmax certificate. Sequence induction applies to the correction precise greedy decision-score/mask scope. No generic deterministic-decoder claim survives.
interpretation_conditions: The strict margin certificate is sufficient, not necessary.
Score-changing processors and adaptive masks need the stated verified score/mask stability bounds.
Stopping agrees when it depends on common tokens/prefix/length, as in fixedEOS/max-length greedy decoding. Any score-dependent stopping decision needs a separate verified stability condition.
Owned-model C2/mixed bounds, coverage, nu and actual prefix margins remain unmeasured; this is no empirical retention or model qualification.
